deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official cUSDO Token indexed deployment table explicitly labels Ethereum ERC20 at this address. Etherscan proxy page and Sourcify both resolve to cUSDO implementation 0xB9413a34f68072a362B6a58F46c6AF36C4e5d890. No fresh storage or runtime identity assertion.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full ABI and compiler-bound source fetched from exact Ethereum implementation address Sourcify v2 response; implementation creation/runtime labels are exact_match and Etherscan implementation says Exact Match. Proxy Sourcify creation/runtime labels are exact_match while its Etherscan proxy source is labelled Similar Match; these service labels are recorded as reported, not conflated. The 48-function implementation ABI is deployment-specific, not generic ERC4626 replacement. No independent compilation/RPC execution performed.

sourceSemantics.evidence: cUSDO extends deployed ERC4626Upgradeable without overriding its four user entry points. The deployed inherited _deposit transfers caller USDO then mints receiver shares; _withdraw spends owner allowance for delegated callers, burns owner shares and transfers assets. Source totalAssets reads actual USDO balance, allowing rebasing yield to increase asset-per-share. cUSDO _beforeTokenTransfer checks USDO.isBanned(from) and combined paused state; it is not an unconditional disabled stub. initialize is one-time and upgrade authorization requires UPGRADE_ROLE. No direct fiat/USDC redemption is implied. No operation-specific role is needed for these four functions, but token/compliance restrictions remain authoritative.

selectedFunctions.label: OpenEden cUSDO deposit
warnings: Ethereum cUSDO wraps rebasing USDO (0x8238884Ec9668Ef77B90C6dfF4D1a9F4F4823BFe), not USDC. Wrap requires caller USDO balance and allowance; unwrap returns USDO, not fiat or USDC redemption.

Upgradeable ERC1967/UUPS proxy; explorer and Sourcify report implementation 0xB9413a34f68072a362B6a58F46c6AF36C4e5d890. This is dated source-binding evidence, not a fresh RPC/storage/runtime attestation. Administrators can upgrade or pause.

The deployed source checks USDO sender bans on share transfers/mint/burn and combines USDO/cUSDO pause states; underlying USDO transfer restrictions also apply. Legal/jurisdiction, sanctions, onboarding or whitelist requirements must not be bypassed. Wrapping does not establish investor eligibility.

ERC4626 asset/share conversion depends on underlying balance, rebases and rounding. No caller-set minimum output, maximum input or deadline; mint rounds assets up, withdraw rounds shares up, deposit/redeem round output down. Do not treat a quote as an execution guarantee.
Withdraw/redeem spend owner share allowance when caller differs from owner; validate receiver/owner and all independent execution controls. All four calls are nonpayable with zero native value.

Official OpenEden docs were read through indexed official-source search excerpts because direct HTTP requests returned 403. No live balances, liquidity, yield, current whitelist/configuration or successful execution is attested; no DAU or vaultTVL claim.
